store.0: Well-organized medication routine using pill planner and phone reminders. Focuses on lifestyle changes(diet, stress, exercise) to reduce medication reliance. Goal: long-term health through proactive, natural management when possible, minimizing unnecessary prescriptions.
store.1: Patient on losartan 50 mg once daily for hypertension. Blood pressure typically ranges 135-140/80-90 mmHg. Doctor recommends stress management and reduced sodium intake instead of increasing dosage. Taking daily magnesium supplement, which may support blood pressure regulation.
store.2: Patient on levothyroxine 75 mcg daily, taken on an empty stomach with a 30-minute wait before eating. Last TSH test: 2.1 mIU/L(within normal range). No dosage changes needed. Noted that missing a dose leads to feeling sluggish the next day; uses a pill organizer to stay on track.
store.3: Osteoarthritis: acetaminophen as needed; meloxicam 7.5 mg intermittently(knees/hands). Doctor warned NSAIDs + losartan may affect kidneys—so meloxicam used sparingly. Levothyroxine taken separately from calcium/iron supplements to avoid absorption issues.

store.5: On atorvastatin 10 mg daily for cholesterol. LDL 130 mg/dL, triglycerides 140 mg/dL initially. Low-dose statin prescribed to improve profile. Cholesterol improving; no side effects like muscle aches reported.
store.6: Patient takes a daily multivitamin, omega-3 supplements for heart health, and probiotics for digestion. Post-gallbladder removal, takes digestive enzymes when consuming heavier or fatty meals. Aware that gallbladder removal affects fat digestion, so mindful of dietary fat intake.
